caption:
No strength left even to turn back? The turning itself is His gift. (Amos 9:11 devotional)

The hand that tore down now rebuilds; even your turning back is His work, not yours. His love is fierce enough to carry even your repentance.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I think I must find the strength to change before God will meet me?
